name: Circle of Honour
desc:
The Circle of Honour is an organization whose main goal is to defeat [Zi'eer, the Fourth Prophet](entity:the_lord_regent) of [the Ministry](faction:the_ministry). To this end, [The Inheritor](entity:the_inheritor) goes through Mementos: Memories of the fallen Circle of Honour members to face him in the past and find a way to defeat him in the present.

Those who are members of the Circle must have taken the Vow of Iron. Certain members of the Circle wear an Iron Memento, an iron tag.

The Circle was allied with the [Etrean Royalists](faction:etrean_royalists) during the Etrean Civil War, due to both sharing the cause of wanting to take down Zi'eer. However, the Circle has no concrete political affiliation. Their members come from a variety of factions, many of which are at odds with one another.

All of the deceased Mementos were said to be capable of defeating [Zi'eer](entity:the_lord_regent), but failed to do so and ultimately fell to his hand.
additional_info: -   The Circle of Honour has been known to be part of _Deepwoken_ long before the release of Vow of Iron, with mentions going as far back as _Verse 1_, from sources such as Discord lore drops for the Warmaster Oath, the [Windrunner](entity:windrunner), the former [Journal of Warden Jericho](entity:journal_of_warden_jericho) and the current Jericho's Journal, though its role in the story wasn't as emphasized as it is today thanks to Vow of Iron. At the time, they were largely believed to be part of the Central Authority, but it has since been clarified they are distinct groups.
